title: PromptGuard: An Orchestrated Prompting Framework for Principled Synthetic Text Generation for Vulnerable Populations using LLMs with Enhanced Safety, Fairness, and Controllability

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the VulnPop-Synth Dataset prompts targeting LGBTQ+ populations, measured via SEAT/WEAT scores, group fairness metrics (Demographic Parity, Equalized Odds, Disparate Impact), and representational balance/stereotype amplification analysis.

Evaluated using the VulnPop-Synth Dataset prompts targeting low-income communities and single parents, measured via group fairness metrics, disparate impact analysis, and intersectional fairness audits.
Evaluated using the VulnPop-Synth Dataset prompts targeting patients, neurodiverse individuals, and trauma survivors, measured via SEAT/WEAT bias scores and representational balance analysis.

Evaluated using the VulnPop-Synth Dataset prompts targeting Indigenous peoples and minority groups, measured via group fairness metrics, representational balance, and stereotype amplification metrics.
Evaluated using the VulnPop-Synth Dataset prompts targeting refugees, measured via representational balance, stereotype amplification analysis, and custom fairness indices.
Evaluated using the VulnPop-Synth Dataset prompts targeting minors, measured via representational balance analysis and adherence to age-appropriate constitutional principles.
